# aether_billing_budget (Resource)

The budget is advisory: nothing is blocked when it is exceeded. The platform evaluates spend about every five minutes and sends ONE `usage.alert` webhook per threshold per organization per UTC calendar month. Thresholds already reached this month are not re-armed by changing the limit or by destroying and recreating the budget; they re-arm at the start of the next month. Any organization member or API token can change the budget (aether-api #310).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Advisory only: nothing is blocked. One usage.alert webhook per threshold per UTC month.
resource "aether_billing_budget" "this" {
  monthly_limit_eur = 500
  thresholds_pct    = [50, 80, 100]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `monthly_limit_eur` (Number) Monthly spend limit in euros, at most two decimals; the platform stores cents. At least `0.01` and less than `10000000000`.
- `thresholds_pct` (List of Number) Percentages of the limit (each 1-100, strictly ascending, at least one) at which a `usage.alert` webhook is sent, e.g. `[50, 80, 100]`.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Time the budget was first set (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) The organization's UUID (the budget has no id of its own).
- `updated_at` (String) Time the budget was last written (RFC 3339).
